sections.name: Verse 1
lines: He and none other; born in our darkness,
If we have seen Him, we have seen the Father:

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: He and none other; no one can serve Him
Who else unites us one in God the Father?

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: He and none other; sold once for silver,
He who redeems us reigns with God the Father.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: God and none other; give God the glory,
Spirit, Son, and Father; give God the glory,
God in Man my brother; Glory to God on high!
